notes: Precursor mixture, not a nanocrystal. Source oxidation state denotes the starting source, not a pure-valence molecular product. Multiple Fe(II)/Fe(III) complexes observed by MALDI.
No single molecular formula or concentration assigned.

quality.review_scope: Complete 11-page main and 19-page matching SI review. Literature protocols/condition families only; no physical batch or independent replication is invented. Numeric image labels retain their original dimensional meaning.
missing_fields: Actual vacuum pressures during 60/120 C drying, numeric room temperature, addition rate, stirring speed in oleate stages.
Recovered carbonate wet/dry mass, preparation yield, fraction transferred to oleate preparation, stock final volume/concentration.
Exact grade/lot for each NC-associated oleate preparation and storage duration.
Single stock molecular composition and oxidation-state population are not established.
conflicts: Na2CO3 16.40 g / 157.7 mmol is inconsistent for the anhydrous formula.
FeCO3 5.69 g / 51.4 mmol is inconsistent for the nominal formula.

quality.review_scope: All six supplied main pages read and visually reviewed; independently audited source extraction and sample links. SI not located or verified. Shared template variants are not independent growth runs. No experimental atomic-structure or exact-size label is asserted.
missing_fields: Matching SI not located or verified.
Initial wafer cleaning reagents/conditions, oxidation temperature/time/atmosphere and wafer doping/resistivity are unreported.
PMMA molecular weight, solvent, solution concentration, coating method and spinning conditions are not reported; no spin-coating step is invented.
Developer ratio basis, bath temperature and development duration are unstated.
CF4/CHF3 flow ratio, etch pressure/power/time and endpoint parameters are unreported; no endpoint detection was used.
10% HF concentration basis, solvent, exact dip duration, rinse/dry and transfer conditions are unreported.
Gas stock fraction and sccm reference basis are unstated; gas purity/supplier, temperature ramp, cool-down and final storage are unreported.
Both well sizes occur on the same substrate/exposure; individual wafer or specimen identifiers are not supplied.
No measured atomic coordinates, XRD/SAED figure, Raman spectrum or near-IR spectrum is supplied.
conflicts: Figure 1 caption gives approximately 60–150 nm photoresist openings, whereas process prose gives approximately 60 and 100 nm; final etched openings are 100 and 150 nm.
Figure 2 body identifies 100 nm wells and a 25 square-micrometre field, whereas its caption identifies 150 nm wells. Keep the image unassigned to either template variant.
Title page prints Received July 6, 1995 and In Final Form November 6, 1994. This internally inconsistent chronology is preserved.
Figure6 caption measured height1.4nm/width33nm; body bounds3.0–34nm and second well3.0–35nm; Summary says3–30nm. These are distinct source descriptions, not a corrected exact diameter.

operations.description: Thermally decompose dilute disilane in the first externally heated quartz zone, forming silicon aerosol and some wall deposit. operations.description: Cool aerosol, pass first through EG prebubbler, then through silanized coarse-glass frit into the EG collection bubbler. Collect both dispersions without conflating them into a single measured batch. Prebubbler is before frit, although paragraph initially introduces the frit first. 2–3 cm3 EG loss in prebubbler per 24 h is an operational observation, not synthesis duration. About two-thirds of collected crystallites appear in second bubbler; one-third Si capture is a separate source-derived mass-efficiency estimate.  Frit pretreatment uses printed SiH2Cl2 in toluene; amount, concentration, treatment duration and wash/dry details are unreported. This upstream treatment is not a simultaneous gas feed.

missing_fields: Preparation, quantitative carrier-solvent composition and purity of the supplied 2 M TOP-S stock.
Exact physical parent CdSe-core batch, seed dispersion volume/carrier and core storage conditions.
Reagent suppliers, purities/lots, flask capacity, stirring, heating rate, gas-flow rate and pressure.
Duration to CdO dissolution, numeric injection duration, post-injection temperature trajectory, final bulk hold endpoint and quench.
Aliquot masses/volumes; the generic TEM workup sampling time; initial ethanol precipitation amount.
Individual centrifugation durations, detailed fraction transfers, final bulk isolation/redispersion and storage.
Original Cirillo et al. 2014 flash method is cited but not independently reviewed in this bounded audit.
Low-acid absolute OA charge and definition of free-versus-total acid ratio.
Exact physical batch identity for the low-OA Figure 1d-f series, its TEM specimen, and any diffraction specimen; no low-OA size or shell-thickness statistic is reported.
conflicts: The parent high-OA method lists 5.6 mmol OA/0.25 mmol CdO (22.4 charged ratio), whereas its results use 20:1. The low-OA branch is labeled 3:1, but the free-versus-total acid basis and absolute low-OA charge are unresolved. No high-OA charge or 8.6 nm size is assigned to this branch.

conflicts: Main text gives 3 psig and 1.22 × 10^5 Pa together, without labeling the latter absolute. They are not the same pressure basis.
